decisions.evidence: Putting the six neighbors together, the three positive neighbors all support mutagenicity, and the three negative neighbors do not provide a convincing counterexample because each one still differs from the query in ways that make the query look more like a carbazole-containing, ring-rich, mutagenicity-prone molecule. The repeated presence of carbazole, the extra ring/basic-site features, and the lack of any strong exposure-limiting pattern that would override those structural signals make option (B) the best final prediction.
